description_en: The default expiration time of the KubeConfig issued by an ACK cluster is 3 years. You can use an Alibaba Cloud account to customize the configuration by invoking the UpdateK8sClusterUserConfigExpire operation to specify the expiration time (1 to 876,000 hours) of the KubeConfig issued to a Resource Access Management (RAM) user or role in an ACK cluster
description_zh: ACK集群下发的KubeConfig过期时间默认为3年。您可以使用阿里云账号（主账号）自定义配置，调用UpdateK8sClusterUserConfigExpire接口指定RAM用户或角色在ACK集群中下发的KubeConfig的过期时间（1～876000小时）
name: UpdateK8sClusterUserConfigExpire

parameters.description_en:
The custom expiration time. Unit: hours.

Valid values: [1, 876000]. The maximum value is equivalent to 100 years.
parameters.description_zh:
用户指定的过期时间。单位：小时。

取值范围：[1, 876000]，即最长为100年。
